records.subject: You're in -- let's get Granite Works set up
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Engaged early: first project reached day 1 and the getting started call was held [calendar:263d2630], so intent exists. But no invite sent and no key milestone 6 days in, no inbound questions or tickets since [email:6c6f5ca6], and only 8 days left. Single-admin accounts with no invite often stay stalled.

draft.subject: Next step after our Granite Works call
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for making time for the getting started call last week -- good to see your first project already created in Wrenfield.

The usual next step from there is bringing a teammate in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you'd rather add several at once.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first invite and how you want projects and tasks laid out for Granite Works.

Best,
Chidi
